title_as_printed: Chemical composition of experimental samples and calculated Y_H2-Cl values.
pressure_note: system pressure set by the syringe pump (ISCO); not stated whether it includes water vapour (fixed-volume reactor, total pressure of the fluid system); phase column vap = low-density vapour sample, SP = single-phase fluid

value.what: dissolved H2 concentration in the sampled fluid (liquid-like single-phase fluid or low-density vapour sample); kg of water vs kg of solution not stated

density.what: density of the sampled fluid, source (measured or calculated) not stated in the table

value2.what: fH2 / [H2(aq)], fH2 from hematite-magnetite buffer via SUPCRT92; kH = 55.51 x Y

KCl.note: Cl measured by IC; K column is measured separately by ICP-OES and agrees within error

composition.other_species: KCl-H2O starting fluid, with K-feldspar, muscovite, quartz, hematite, magnetite present (pH/fO2 buffers); 200 umol/kg formic acid added as H2 source; kg basis (water or solution) not stated

conversion_needs: molality vs mass-of-solution basis not stated
Henry-like constant per experiment is derived by authors from buffer fugacity, not measured
T in C, bar; high T 400-500 C, vapour and single-phase fluid rows both present
notes: 18 rows, all in one block. Ti-alloy reactor; fH2 fixed by hematite-magnetite buffer. Phase vap rows are low-density vapour samples (H2 dissolved concentration in the sampled fluid, not a gas-phase mole fraction).
